package internalapi

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"mime"
	"net/http"
	"reflect"
	"unicode/utf8"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

// PlanningSnapshotGetter reads one owner observation. It is not a planning
// evaluator, permission grant, progress command, or idempotency receipt writer.
type PlanningSnapshotGetter interface {
	Handle(context.Context, string, string, domain.PlanningSnapshotRequest) (domain.StudentPlanningSnapshot, error)
}

const planningSnapshotRequestLimit = domain.MaximumPlanningSnapshotRequestBytes
const planningSnapshotResponseLimit = domain.MaximumPlanningSnapshotPayloadBytes

// GetPlanningSnapshot is prepared independently of router registration. The
// composition root and dedicated Planner route are wired after the owner RED.
func (handler *Handler) GetPlanningSnapshot(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	studentID, pathID := chi.URLParam(r, "studentID"), chi.URLParam(r, "pathID")
	if !canonicalPlanningSnapshotID(studentID) || !canonicalPlanningSnapshotID(pathID) {
		writePlanningSnapshotError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_planning_snapshot_identity")
		return
	}
	request, err := decodePlanningSnapshotRequest(w, r)
	if err != nil {
		writePlanningSnapshotError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_planning_snapshot_request")
		return
	}
	if handler.PlanningSnapshot == nil {
		writePlanningSnapshotError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "planning_snapshot_unconfigured")
		return
	}
	result, err := handler.PlanningSnapshot.Handle(r.Context(), studentID, pathID, request)
	if err != nil {
		switch {
		case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation):
			writePlanningSnapshotError(w, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "invalid_planning_snapshot_request")
		case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound):
			writePlanningSnapshotError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "planning_snapshot_not_found")
		case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict), errors.Is(err, domain.ErrInvalidStatus):
			writePlanningSnapshotError(w, http.StatusConflict, "planning_snapshot_conflict")
		default:
			writePlanningSnapshotError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "planning_snapshot_unavailable")
		}
		return
	}
	result, err = domain.NormalizeStudentPlanningSnapshot(result)
	if err != nil || result.StudentID != studentID || result.LearningPathID != pathID ||
		!reflect.DeepEqual(result.RequestedTargets, request.Targets) || result.TriggerContext != request.TriggerContext {
		writePlanningSnapshotError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "planning_snapshot_unavailable")
		return
	}
	// Marshal the typed whitelist completely before publishing any response.
	// Technical oversize fails closed; no protected state is silently truncated.
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(result)
	if err != nil || len(encoded) > planningSnapshotResponseLimit {
		writePlanningSnapshotError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "planning_snapshot_unavailable")
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	_, _ = w.Write(encoded)
}

func canonicalPlanningSnapshotID(value string) bool {
	parsed, err := uuid.Parse(value)
	return err == nil && parsed != uuid.Nil && parsed.String() == value
}

func writePlanningSnapshotError(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, code string) {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(status)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]string{"error": code})
}

func decodePlanningSnapshotRequest(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) (domain.PlanningSnapshotRequest, error) {
	contentType, _, err := mime.ParseMediaType(r.Header.Get("Content-Type"))
	if err != nil || contentType != "application/json" {
		return domain.PlanningSnapshotRequest{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	raw, err := io.ReadAll(http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, planningSnapshotRequestLimit))
	if err != nil || !utf8.Valid(raw) {
		return domain.PlanningSnapshotRequest{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(raw))
	decoder.UseNumber()
	value, err := readPlanningSnapshotJSONValue(decoder, 0)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.PlanningSnapshotRequest{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if _, err = decoder.Token(); err != io.EOF {
		return domain.PlanningSnapshotRequest{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	root, ok := value.(map[string]any)
	if !ok || !planningSnapshotJSONKeys(root, "targets", "trigger_context") {
		return domain.PlanningSnapshotRequest{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	targets, ok := root["targets"].([]any)
	if !ok || len(targets) < 1 || len(targets) > 500 {
		return domain.PlanningSnapshotRequest{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	for _, value := range targets {
		target, ok := value.(map[string]any)
		if !ok || !planningSnapshotJSONKeys(target, "type", "key", "version") {
			return domain.PlanningSnapshotRequest{}, domain.ErrValidation
		}
	}
	trigger, ok := root["trigger_context"].(map[string]any)
	if !ok || !planningSnapshotJSONKeys(trigger, "kind", "reason", "correlation_id") {
		return domain.PlanningSnapshotRequest{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if value, present := trigger["correlation_id"]; present {
		correlationID, ok := value.(string)
		if !ok || !canonicalPlanningSnapshotID(correlationID) {
			return domain.PlanningSnapshotRequest{}, domain.ErrValidation
		}
	}
	var request domain.PlanningSnapshotRequest
	decoder = json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(raw))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if decoder.Decode(&request) != nil || decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}) != io.EOF {
		return domain.PlanningSnapshotRequest{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return domain.NormalizePlanningSnapshotRequest(request)
}

// Token parsing rejects duplicate keys and null anywhere, including nested
// target/trace fields. A typed decoder alone silently accepts both in Go.
func readPlanningSnapshotJSONValue(decoder *json.Decoder, depth int) (any, error) {
	if depth > 8 {
		return nil, errors.New("invalid JSON nesting")
	}
	token, err := decoder.Token()
	if err != nil || token == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("invalid JSON value")
	}
	delimiter, compound := token.(json.Delim)
	if !compound {
		return token, nil
	}
	switch delimiter {
	case '{':
		object := map[string]any{}
		for decoder.More() {
			keyToken, err := decoder.Token()
			key, ok := keyToken.(string)
			if err != nil || !ok {
				return nil, errors.New("invalid JSON key")
			}
			if _, duplicate := object[key]; duplicate {
				return nil, errors.New("duplicate JSON key")
			}
			value, err := readPlanningSnapshotJSONValue(decoder, depth+1)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			object[key] = value
		}
		if close, err := decoder.Token(); err != nil || close != json.Delim('}') {
			return nil, errors.New("invalid JSON object")
		}
		return object, nil
	case '[':
		array := []any{}
		for decoder.More() {
			value, err := readPlanningSnapshotJSONValue(decoder, depth+1)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			array = append(array, value)
		}
		if close, err := decoder.Token(); err != nil || close != json.Delim(']') {
			return nil, errors.New("invalid JSON array")
		}
		return array, nil
	default:
		return nil, errors.New("invalid JSON delimiter")
	}
}

func planningSnapshotJSONKeys(object map[string]any, allowed ...string) bool {
	for key := range object {
		found := false
		for _, candidate := range allowed {
			if key == candidate {
				found = true
				break
			}
		}
		if !found {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}
